{{Quote|My friend. Welcome to Moenia. The starport is a bustling center of commerce and community. And the swamp is an endless source of adventure.|[[Bertos Goodner]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BG">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=conversation|Bertos Goodner|Naboo}}</ref>}}
'''Moenia''' was a large [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] known for its importance as a booming [[Artist/Legends|artists]]' retreat.

==Description==
Protected by the dense swamplands of the [[Gungan Swamp]], Moenia was an ideal [[City/Legends|city]] for [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] educated elite. The city boasted Naboo's highest concentration of successful [[Author/Legends|authors]], [[Artist/Legends|artists]] and [[Musician/Legends|musicians]]. It was also the training ground for many of Naboo's elected officials, and included some of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] most respected universities.<ref name="SWG:M" /> Inhabitants of Moenia also encompassed many merchants and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] sympathizers.<ref name="EG" />

Moenia usually had a misty gloom about it. While inside the city, one could rarely tell if it was day or night.<ref name="SWG" /> Perhaps this was why Moenia chose to host the [[Galactic Moon Festival]].<ref name="SWG:GMF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=event|Galactic Moon Festival}}</ref>

==History==
During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Moenia was conquered by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], and its population was relocated to the [[Camp Six|Detention Camp Six]], outside the city.<ref name="EG" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] viewed Moenia as little more than an artist's retreat and virtually ignored all activity in the city. This allowed for the formation of a small but influential group of political idealists sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]. Publicly, Moenia's leadership would support the Empire, but they surreptitiously funded Alliance activities, welcomed refugees from worlds under Imperial siege, and arranged meetings between Rebel agents and powerful political figures from throughout the galaxy. While the peaceful residents of Moenia would rarely take up arms against the Empire, their underground support of the Alliance proved to be a valuable asset.<ref name="SWG:M" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the city eventually became a Rebel Alliance stronghold.<ref name="GG" />

The [[Aerie Casino]] was located on the city's outskirts. A grand opening of this [[Casino/Legends|casino]] occurred in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="TRoD" />

==Inhabitants==
Residents of or visitors to the city in the time after the Battle of Yavin included [[Dilvin Lormurojo]], [[Borvo's guard]], [[C-3TC]], [[Ronin Lightrunner]],<ref name="SWG" /> and [[V3-FX]].<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> Among the city's more famous patrons was the famed [[Poet/Legends|poet]], philologist, and scholar [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]].<ref name="SWG" /> [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was also known to relax in the local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. From there, he managed [[Borvo's Vault|his own vault]] just outside the city. This vault was actually a large underground bunker, rumored to have an [[Borvo's acklay|acklay]] and [[Borvo's rancor|rancor]] guarding its secrets.<ref name="SWG:ORDMBBD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Old Republic Droid Modules: Borvo's Battle Droid|Naboo}}</ref>
